description: Short real-run smoke for 11_cpc (visual CPC 2018, native patch-encoder path): pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. The paper's 7x7 patch grid is shrunk to the smallest the port allows (the dataset relaxes the grid check to >=2x2 'so a small hermetic CPU smoke can run'): img_size 32, patch_size 16, stride 16 -> a 2x2 grid, at which the InfoNCE loss still predicts one future row (pred_steps 1). The ResNet-v2-101 patch encoder is narrowed via encoder_width_mult and z_dim/c_dim. Every model and patch-grid key is set identically in both stages, because linear_eval rebuilds the encoder from them to load encoder.pt (adapter.load_encoder).
